summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Sour Apple VIP Laundry MVP. 27/29 pytest tests passed (93%). Only failures are AI endpoints (Emergent LLM key BUDGET EXCEEDED at provider level, NOT a code bug). Frontend E2E flows verified for all 3 roles: Student login/schedule/submit/QR display, Admin dashboard w/ filters + booking requests, Driver available-jobs screen. Role-based redirects and role enforcement all working.

critical.issue: Both return 500. Backend log: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (sk-emergent-2639fA3BdF7B62d248) has 0 budget on the provider side. Code is correct — issue is the key/budget. Main agent should request a fresh Emergent LLM key with budget or verify the key was properly issued.

integration_issues.issue: price-estimate testID sometimes shows stale value (e.g., $75) briefly before submit; backend returns correct $85. Minor debounce/UX polish, not a functional bug.

design_issues.screen: Driver tab bar / Admin tab bar
issues: Bottom-tab labels appear slightly clipped at the bottom on 390x844 viewport (labels 'Available', 'My Jobs' partly cut). Consider paddingBottom on tab bar / SafeAreaView.

action_items: Fix Emergent LLM budget/key so /ai/stain-tips and /ai/support return 200. This is the ONLY backend blocker.
(Optional) Tighten price-estimate debounce so displayed estimate matches submitted total instantly.
(Optional) Add SafeArea/paddingBottom to Driver + Admin bottom tab bar so labels aren't clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 695 lines — acceptable for MVP but nearing the 700 threshold; consider splitting into routers/{auth,orders,admin,driver,ai}.py.
/admin/jobs/{id}/assign overloads StatusUpdate.status field to carry driver_id — misleading naming; add dedicated AssignBody model.
release_job has dead-code `if ... pass` block (lines 418-421); either enforce the state check or remove.
/orders/estimate is public (no auth) — acceptable but should be documented.
Order pop('_id', None) done post-insert; other endpoints already use projection {_id:0} — pattern is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, login all 3 roles, student schedule + submit, order tracking with QR, admin dashboard, driver jobs)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users and one live order (SA-F0CD2B2A) plus a reorder. No manual DB seed needed — server.py already seeds admin/student/driver + sample order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_sourapple_api.py. Re-run after LLM key fix — the two AI tests (test_ai_stain_tips, test_ai_support_admin_only) should then pass. Frontend testIDs are well-scaffolded: welcome-screen, get-started-button, login-*, student-home, schedule-cta, service-*, bags-plus/minus, rush-toggle, bedding-toggle, pref-*, stain-input, ai-tips-button, price-estimate, submit-order-button, admin-requests-screen, filter-*, admin-order-*, driver-available-screen.
rca_of_issue: AI 500s — root cause: emergentintegrations chat call fails at LiteLLM layer because provider budget on the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is 0. Mitigation: obtain a new EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with non-zero budget from Emergent and replace in backend/.env, then restart backend. No code change needed.
